question: How are loan payments handled?

evidence: Loan payments are due on the scheduled due date listed in the borrower agreement.

stdout:
Loan payments are handled as follows:

When a borrower misses a scheduled loan payment, the account enters a grace period. During this period the borrower may submit the required payment without the account immediately being classified as delinquent. [examples/large-loan-policy.md - Missed Payments]

The grace period lasts fifteen days. [examples/large-loan-policy.md - Missed Payments]

The borrower may receive reminders explaining that payment is still required and providing information about available payment methods. [examples/large-loan-policy.md - Missed Payments]

If the required payment is not received before the grace period expires, the account becomes delinquent. [examples/large-loan-policy.md - Missed Payments]

The servicing system records the delinquency and may generate additional notifications for the borrower. [examples/large-loan-policy.md - Missed Payments]

A delinquent borrower may be contacted by the servicing team. [examples/large-loan-policy.md - Missed Payments]
